conventions.convention: The preparation consists of finitely many noninteracting, nonzero finite-dimensional cells with Hermitian H_i and number matrices Q_i satisfying [H_i,Q_i]=0. The global smooth potential, compensator and whole-future-mass-shell stationarity hypotheses of the finite-cell supplier are retained.
N_i is dimensionless, β_K=1/(k_B T_K), β_i=N_i β_K, and N_i μ_i+q Φ_i=μ_K. The adopted density is the normalized tensor product of the individual cell Gibbs densities.

KMS uses bounded, closed-strip-continuous functions, holomorphic inside, with lower boundary ω(A α_t(B)) and upper boundary ω(α_t(B)A). For physical time in seconds the width is ℏβ. The convention was checked against [Naaijkens §3.4](https://arxiv.org/html/1311.2717v2) and [Ruelle I §7](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math-ph/0107009).

The geometric curve satisfies γ_i'=cξ and proper time satisfies τ=N_i t_K. The lapse is constant along each selected orbit; the finite-matrix dynamics exist for all real parameters even when the geometric flow interval is limited.
Full-algebra KMS concerns grand-generator dynamics. Identification with physical-Hamiltonian dynamics is restricted to observables commuting with the number matrix.

A proper-time control H_i−εh(τ)B corresponds to Killing-time control H_{K,i}−εN_i h(N_i t)B. The retarded kernel has sign +i/ℏ. Finite-time response fixes the initial density; the static Kubo–Mori derivative concerns a separately re-prepared Gibbs family.

The Fourier convention is S(ω)=∫e^{iωt}C(t)dt distributionally. Spectral measures transform by pushforward under ω↦N_iω, preserving atomic weights. Zero-frequency atoms remain separate from the nonzero-frequency coth formula.

Countable Choice is retained through the smooth geometric suppliers; no stronger choice principle is claimed. All predictions are conditional model deductions, with no empirical premises, thermalization claim or measured realization.

load_bearing.statement: Adopts the actually constructed finite product Gibbs state of thm-tgr-finite-cell-gibbs-factorization under that theorem's full stationary, global-potential, compensator and whole-shell hypotheses. The state is β_K-KMS for Killing-time grand-generator dynamics; its neutral restriction is KMS for physical H_K dynamics. No infinite-volume state, thermalization or empirical realization is asserted.

Under the stated connected smooth stationary geometry, global compensator, whole-future-mass-shell stationarity and Countable Choice hypotheses, finitely many independent nonzero finite-dimensional cells with [H_i,Q_i]=0 have positive finite partition sums, Z=∏Z_i, and ρ=⊗ρ_i. The state is grand-generator KMS, and physical-Hamiltonian KMS on the neutral subalgebra.

For a unital complex C*-algebra, strongly continuous automorphism group and β_K-KMS state, the group α^λ_τ=α_{τ/λ}, with constant λ>0, has the same state as a λβ_K-KMS state. Conversely, a β̂-KMS state for α^λ is β̂/λ-KMS for α. In the stated stationary geometry, τ=Nt_K on a selected orbit and T_loc=T_K/N.

For one cell of the specified independent-cell Gibbs construction, neutral Hermitian A,B and a continuous finite-duration control, E_K(t)=E_loc(Nt). The finite-time Kubo expansions have matching first-order terms and quadratic remainder bounds under the prescribed control rescaling; spectral measures obey S_K=(D_N)_*S_loc. The separate static Gibbs derivative is β_loc Cov_KM(B,B)≥0, with the stated variance and zero-frequency qualifications.

For one cell of the adopted preparation, ω_i is β_K-KMS for its Killing-time grand-generator dynamics and N_iβ_K-KMS for its proper-time grand-generator dynamics. On the neutral algebra the latter dynamics agree with those generated by H_i. Thus T_i=T_K/N_i, orbitwise.

concerns.concern: Verification step 2.1 says, “The forward direction of [F2] therefore gives whole-future-shell stationarity”. The cited equivalence is written as stationarity iff β is Killing and dζ=−cq ι_βF. This step establishes the right-hand conditions and infers stationarity, so it uses the reverse direction as written. The inference itself is valid.
